requestTimeout: The server did not answer in time. It may still be working — reload to see the current state.

signIn.title: This wrapper asks for a credential
signIn.tokenBody: Agentry is running with token authentication. Paste the token you were given when it was created; it is kept in this browser only.
signIn.oidcBody: Agentry is running with OIDC authentication. Paste an access token from your identity provider, or reach the wrapper through the proxy that adds one.
signIn.label: Token
signIn.rejected: That credential was not accepted. Check it has not expired and that it is the one this wrapper knows.
signIn.failed: The wrapper could not be reached to check the credential.
signIn.hint: A token is shown once, when it is created. Lost it? Rotate it from the machine that runs Agentry.
